notes.title: Die Cook v1.1 Update
notes.content:
Added Features:

 Employee training: Employees can now undergo paid training. Cost $25 base + $25 per current level of the employee. They will not work (roll dice) for the next 4 hours).
 Shop restock: You can now pay to instantly restock the shop. Cost is $25 first time, then $25 more each time you pay for a restock.
 Added Achievements for both of the above.


Balance tweaks:

 Shop item appearance requirements lowered.
 New Game initial shop has more options.
 Lowered % chance of multiple sides early game.
 Lowered % chance of needing 2 dice to cook an item early game.
 Increased % chance change of needing 2 dice to cook an item with each level of "Ingredient Quality" upgrade.


Misc:

 Employee Happiness shows on their ID.
 If an employee is currently training that will show on their ID as well.

notes.title: Die Cook v1.02 Update
notes.content:
Hello Chefs!

We have another update, and this one may seem small but has some key changes that should make the game balance a lot better overall. It'll still be very tough early on if you start as a high wage employee and with multiple food items, but the mid-late game should be less of a breeze and obtaining a 5-Star rating will take longer and require a lot more upgrades to obtain.

Changes:

Upgrades that affect # of tickets have been tweaked for a better mid-late game experience.
Upgrade descriptions have been updated.
Upgrade prices and upkeep have been adjusted for better balancing.
Hidden rating cap is now affected by # of items on your menu, # of upgrades purchased, and # of incoming tickets in a single day.
New hidden achievement added for an easter egg that was already in the game.
Version # added to main menu.


Bug Fixes:

New upgrade data or changes will load into an existing save.
Achievement stat tracking updated to fix a couple that weren't working.

notes.title: Die Cook v1.01
notes.content:
Various changes implemented in this update. Mostly fixes for mechanics and some balancing adjustments on items that weren't working as expected.

Balancing tweaks & other changes:

Orders per hour calculation adjusted. Rating factors into potential additional orders.
Group size (parking lot upgrade) properly factoring into orders.
Rating calculation adjustment. Rating cap factors in total # of active menu items.


Squashed Bugs:

Firing an employee after a roll and using their dice.
Upgrade level not applying correctly upon loading a save.
Weekly stats summary screen.
Using a special "Cook" dice on cold foods.
